#!/bin/bash
function read_ini() {
    SECTION=$1
    KEY=$2
    FILE=$3
    RESULT=$(sed -n "/^\[$SECTION\]/,/^\[/{/^$KEY=/p}" $FILE | sed "s/^$KEY=//")
    echo $RESULT
function write_ini() {
    SECTION=$1
    KEY=$2
    VALUE=$3
    FILE=$4
    if grep -q "^\[$SECTION\]" $FILE; then
        if grep -A1000 "^\[$SECTION\]" $FILE | grep -m1 -q "^$KEY="; then
            # 
            sed -i "/^\[$SECTION\]/,/^\[/{s/^$KEY=.*/$KEY=$VALUE/}" $FILE
        else
            # 
            sed -i "/^\[$SECTION\]/a $KEY=$VALUE" $FILE
        fi
    else
        # 
        echo -e "\n[$SECTION]\n$KEY=$VALUE" >> $FILE
    fi
configure_5g() {
    # 
    
    # 
 usb0 
 WAN 
    uci -q delete network.4g
    uci set network.4g="interface"
    uci set network.4g.proto="dhcp"
    uci set network.4g.ifname="usb0"
    uci commit network
    
    uci delete system.led_2g
    uci delete system.led_3g
    
    uci commit system 
    # 
    /etc/init.d/network reload 
    sync

get_4g_signal() {
    # echo -e "AT+CFUN=1,1\r\n" >/dev/ttyUSB2
# sleep 3
    echo cat $DEVICE > "$TEMPFILE" &
    cat $DEVICE > "$TEMPFILE" &
    CAT_PID=$!
    sleep 1
    # 
 AT 
 ICCID
    echo -e "AT+CCID\r" > $DEVICE
    # 
    TIMEOUT=10
    COUNTER=0
    while [ "$COUNTER" -lt "$TIMEOUT" ]; do
        sleep 2
        RESPONSE=$(grep "+CCID" "$TEMPFILE")
        if [ -n "$RESPONSE" ]; then
            ICCID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed -n 's/.*+CCID: //p')
            if [ -n "$ICCID" ]; then
                break
            fi
        fi
        echo -e "AT+CCID\r" > $DEVICE
        COUNTER=$(expr $COUNTER + 1)
    done
    # 
    SIGNAL_TIMEOUT=10
    SIGNAL_COUNTER=0
    while [ "$SIGNAL_COUNTER" -lt "$SIGNAL_TIMEOUT" ]; do
        echo -e "AT+CSQ\r" > $DEVICE
        sleep 2
        SIGNAL_RESPONSE=$(grep "+CSQ" "$TEMPFILE")
        if [ -n "$SIGNAL_RESPONSE" ]; then
            SIGNAL_QUALITY=$(echo "$SIGNAL_RESPONSE" | sed -n 's/.*+CSQ: \([0-9]*\),.*/\1/p')
            if [ -n "$SIGNAL_QUALITY" ]; then
                echo "
: $SIGNAL_QUALITY" 
                
                echo "
: $SIGNAL_QUALITY\n" >>iot.log
                break
            fi
        fi
        SIGNAL_COUNTER=$(expr $SIGNAL_COUNTER + 1)
    done
    if [ -z "$SIGNAL_QUALITY" ]; then
        echo "
    fi
    # 
 cat 
    kill "$CAT_PID"
    wait "$CAT_PID" 2>/dev/null
    # 
 ICCID
    if [ -n "$ICCID" ]; then
        echo "SIM
ICCID: $ICCID"
        echo "SIM
ICCID: $ICCID">>iot.log
        # write_ini "setting" "iccid" "$ICCID" "setting.ini"
    else
        echo "SIM
ICCID: 
        echo "SIM
ICCID: unknow">>iot.log
        #  write_ini "setting" "iccid" "unknow" "setting.ini"
    fi
# # 
# HOST=$(read_ini "Database" "host" "config.ini")
# echo "
Host: $HOST"
# write_ini "Database" "host" "127.0.0.1" "config.ini"
# NEW_HOST=$(read_ini "Database" "host" "config.ini")
# echo "
Host: $NEW_HOST"
DEVICE="/dev/ttyUSB2"
TEMPFILE="/tmp/.ttyUSB2"
# echo -e "AT+QCFG=\"usbnet\",3\r\n" > /dev/ttyUSB2 
# sleep 5
# echo 0 > /sys/class/gpio/pcie4g/value
# sleep 5
echo 1 > /sys/class/gpio/pcie4g/value
count=0
DEVICE_FOUND=false  # 
while [ $count -lt 20 ]; do
     # 
 5G 
 usb0
usb1
usb2)
if  [ -d /sys/class/net/usb1 ] || [ -d /sys/class/net/usb2 ]; then
        logger -t "my_modem_init" "Detected 5G interface. Configuring 5G..."
        configure_5g
        write_ini "oldma" "lte_type" "5g" "/etc/oldma.ini"
        DEVICE_FOUND=true
        break
    # 
 usb0/1/2
 wwan0
elif [ -d /sys/class/net/wwan0 ]; then
        logger -t "my_modem_init" "Detected 4G interface. Configuring 4G..."
        configure_4g
        
        write_ini "oldma" "lte_type" "4g" "/etc/oldma.ini"
        DEVICE_FOUND=true
        get_4g_signal
        break
elif [ -d /sys/class/net/usb0 ]  &&  [ ! -d /sys/class/net/usb2 ]; then
        configure_4g
        echo -e "AT+QCFG=\"usbnet\",0\r\n" > /dev/ttyUSB2 
        write_ini "oldma" "lte_type" "4g" "/etc/oldma.ini"
        logger -t "my_modem_init" "old version 4g!"
        if [ -e "$DEVICE" ]; then
        echo -e "AT+CFUN=1,1\r\n" >/dev/ttyUSB2
        echo "
 $DEVICE 
        # 
        fi
        break
    count=$((count + 1))
    sleep 1  # 
done

      function normalizeLink(to, location = history.location) {
        to = to || '';
        if (to && to[0] === '#') {
          to = location.pathname + location.search + to;
        } else if (to && to[0] === '?') {
          to = location.pathname + to;
        }
        const idx = to.indexOf('?');
        const idx2 = to.indexOf('#');
        let pathname = ~idx
          ? to.substring(0, idx)
          : ~idx2
            ? to.substring(0, idx2)
            : to;
        let search = ~idx ? to.substring(idx, ~idx2 ? idx2 : undefined) : '';
        let hash = ~idx2 ? to.substring(idx2) : location.hash;
        if (!pathname) {
          pathname = location.pathname;
        } else if (pathname[0] != '/' && !/^https?\:\/\//.test(pathname)) {
          let relativeBase = location.pathname;
          const paths = relativeBase.split('/');
          paths.pop();
          let m;
          while ((m = /^\.\.?\//.exec(pathname))) {
            if (m[0] === '../') {
              paths.pop();
            }
            pathname = pathname.substring(m[0].length);
          }
          pathname = paths.concat(pathname).join('/');
        }
        return pathname + search + hash;
      }
      function isCurrentUrl(to, ctx) {
        if (!to) {
          return false;
        }
        const pathname = history.location.pathname;
        const link = normalizeLink(to, {
          ...location,
          pathname,
          hash: ''
        });
        if (!~link.indexOf('http') && ~link.indexOf(':')) {
          let strict = ctx && ctx.strict;
          return match(link, {
            decode: decodeURIComponent,
            strict: typeof strict !== 'undefined' ? strict : true
          })(pathname);
        }
        return decodeURI(pathname) === link;
      }

            // +            console.log('api', api)

              }
            }
            // console.log(api);
            return api;
          },
          responseAdaptor(api, payload, qurey, request, response) {
            if (response.status == 403 || response.status == 401 || response.status == 405) {
              window.location = "/login.html";
            }
            if (payload.status != null) {
              payload.status = payload.status == 200 ? 0 : payload.status;
            }
            if (payload.result != null) {
              var stat = payload.status == 200 ? 0 : payload.status;

              return data;
            }
            if (api.url.indexOf(".json") > 0) {
              // var jsonObj = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('permisson'));
              // //

              // if (payload.data == null) {
              //   payload.data = jsonObj
              // }
              // else {

              //   payload.data = result
              // }
              //  console.log(payload);
            }
            // var data = { xxx: true }
            // if (payload.type != null)
            //    payload.data =data;
            return payload;
          },
          updateLocation: (location, replace) => {
            location = normalizeLink(location);
            if (location === 'goBack') {
              return history.goBack();
            } else if (
              (!/^https?\:\/\//.test(location) &&
                location ===
                history.location.pathname + history.location.search) ||
              location === history.location.href
            ) {
              // 
              return;
            } else if (/^https?\:\/\//.test(location) || !history) {
              return (window.location.href = location);
            }
            history[replace ? 'replace' : 'push'](location);
          },
          jumpTo: (to, action) => {
            if (to === 'goBack') {
              return history.goBack();
            }
            to = normalizeLink(to);
            if (isCurrentUrl(to)) {
              return;
            }
            if (action && action.actionType === 'url') {
              action.blank === false
                ? (window.location.href = to)
                : window.open(to, '_blank');
              return;
            } else if (action && action.blank) {
              window.open(to, '_blank');
              return;
            }

      function normalizeLink(to, location = history.location) {
        to = to || '';
        if (to && to[0] === '#') {
          to = location.pathname + location.search + to;
        } else if (to && to[0] === '?') {
          to = location.pathname + to;
        }
        const idx = to.indexOf('?');
        const idx2 = to.indexOf('#');
        let pathname = ~idx
          ? to.substring(0, idx)
          : ~idx2
            ? to.substring(0, idx2)
            : to;
        let search = ~idx ? to.substring(idx, ~idx2 ? idx2 : undefined) : '';
        let hash = ~idx2 ? to.substring(idx2) : location.hash;
        if (!pathname) {
          pathname = location.pathname;
        } else if (pathname[0] != '/' && !/^https?\:\/\//.test(pathname)) {
          let relativeBase = location.pathname;
          const paths = relativeBase.split('/');
          paths.pop();
          let m;
          while ((m = /^\.\.?\//.exec(pathname))) {
            if (m[0] === '../') {
              paths.pop();
            }
            pathname = pathname.substring(m[0].length);
          }
          pathname = paths.concat(pathname).join('/');
        }
        return pathname + search + hash;
      }
      function isCurrentUrl(to, ctx) {
        if (!to) {
          return false;
        }
        const pathname = history.location.pathname;
        const link = normalizeLink(to, {
          ...location,
          pathname,
          hash: ''
        });
        if (!~link.indexOf('http') && ~link.indexOf(':')) {
          let strict = ctx && ctx.strict;
          return match(link, {
            decode: decodeURIComponent,
            strict: typeof strict !== 'undefined' ? strict : true
          })(pathname);
        }
        return decodeURI(pathname) === link;
      }
      let amisInstance = amis.embed(
        '#root',
        app,
        {
          location: history.location
        },
        {
          // watchRouteChange: fn => {
          //   return history.listen(fn);
          // },
          requestAdaptor(api) {
            // api.headers["X-Access-Token"] = localStorage.getItem('X-Access-Token')
            // +            console.log('api', api)
            // +            return api;
            if (api.data != null) {
              if (api.data.page != null) {
                // api.data.pageIndex = api.data.page - 1;
              }
              if (api.data.perPage != null) {
                // api.data.pageSize = api.data.perPage;
              }
            }
            // console.log(api);
            return api;
          },
          responseAdaptor(api, payload, qurey, request, response) {
            if (response.status == 403 || response.status == 401 || response.status == 405) {
              window.location = "/cdn_login.html";
            }
            if (payload.status != null) {
              payload.status = payload.status == 200 ? 0 : payload.status;
            }
            if (payload.result != null) {
              var stat = payload.status == 200 ? 0 : payload.status;
              var data = { data: payload.result, status: stat, message: payload.message }
              return data;
            }
            if (api.url.indexOf(".json") > 0) {
              // var jsonObj = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('permisson'));
              // //
dada
              // if (payload.data == null) {
              //   payload.data = jsonObj
              // }
              // else {
              //   const result = Object.assign(jsonObj, payload.data);
              //   payload.data = result
              // }
              //  console.log(payload);
            }
            // var data = { xxx: true }
            // if (payload.type != null)
            //    payload.data =data;
            return payload;
          },
          updateLocation: (location, replace) => {
            location = normalizeLink(location);
            if (location === 'goBack') {
              return history.goBack();
            } else if (
              (!/^https?\:\/\//.test(location) &&
                location ===
                history.location.pathname + history.location.search) ||
              location === history.location.href
            ) {
              // 
              return;
            } else if (/^https?\:\/\//.test(location) || !history) {
              return (window.location.href = location);
            }
            history[replace ? 'replace' : 'push'](location);
          },
          jumpTo: (to, action) => {
            if (to === 'goBack') {
              return history.goBack();
            }
            to = normalizeLink(to);
            if (isCurrentUrl(to)) {
              return;
            }
            if (action && action.actionType === 'url') {
              action.blank === false
                ? (window.location.href = to)
                : window.open(to, '_blank');
              return;
            } else if (action && action.blank) {
              window.open(to, '_blank');
              return;
            }
            if (/^https?:\/\//.test(to)) {
              window.location.href = to;
            } else if (
              (!/^https?\:\/\//.test(to) &&
                to === history.pathname + history.location.search) ||
              to === history.location.href
            ) {
              // do nothing

            }

    function deepFilter(para) {
        // 
filter 
        if (para == null)
            return false;
        console.log(para);
        return para.filter(item => {
            // filter
            // 
children 
 deepFilter 
            // if(item.children !=null)
            item.children = deepFilter(item.children)
            // 
            // arch="MIPS"
            if ("X86" == arch)
                return true;
            if ("ARM64" == arch)
                return true;
            console.log(arch)
            return item.arch.includes(arch)

    arch = localStorage.getItem('arch')
    appId = localStorage.getItem('appId')
    authLev = localStorage.getItem('authLev')
    function deepFilter(para) {
        // 
filter 
        if (para == null)
            return false;
        // console.log(para);
        return para.filter(item => {
            // filter
            // 
children 
 deepFilter 
            // if(item.children !=null)
            item.children = deepFilter(item.children)
            return true;
            if (authLev < item.level) {
                return false;//
            }
            if (item.appId != null && item.appId != "CNC") {
                return false;//
            }
            // 
            // arch="MIPS"
            if ("X86" == arch)
                return true;
            if ("ARM64" == arch)
                return true;
            // console.log(authLev)
            // console.log(item.level)
            return item.arch.includes(arch)
            // return item.disabled
        })
    }

 deepFilter

    window.saveDeviceInfo = function(deviceData) {
        if (deviceData.protocol) {
            localStorage.setItem('protocol', deviceData.protocol);
            if(deviceData.protocol.includes(":")){
                localStorage.setItem('device_type', deviceData.protocol.split(":")[0]);
            }
            else{
                localStorage.setItem('device_type', deviceData.protocol);
            }
        }
        if (deviceData.ip) {
            localStorage.setItem('ip', deviceData.ip);
        }
        if (deviceData.id) {
            localStorage.setItem('id', deviceData.id);
        }
        if (deviceData.name) {
            localStorage.setItem('name', deviceData.name);
        }
        if (deviceData.remark) {
            localStorage.setItem('remark', deviceData.remark);
        }
        if (deviceData.mqttDeviceId) {
            localStorage.setItem('mqttDeviceId', deviceData.mqttDeviceId);
        }
    }

    function deepFilter(para) {
        // 
filter 
        if (para == null)
            return false;
        // console.log(para);
        return para.filter(item => {
            // filter
            // 
children 
 deepFilter 
            // if(item.children !=null)
            item.children = deepFilter(item.children)
            if (authLev < item.level) {
                return false;//
            }
            if (item.appId != null && item.appId != "PLC") {
                return false;//
            }
            // 
            // arch="MIPS"
            if ("X86" == arch)
                return true;
            if ("ARM64" == arch)
                return true;
            // console.log(authLev)
            // console.log(item.level)
            return item.arch.includes(arch)

    // 
    var DeviceInfoManager = {
        // 
localStorage
        saveDeviceInfo: function(deviceData) {
            if (deviceData.templateId) {
                localStorage.setItem('templateId', deviceData.templateId);
            }
            if (deviceData.deviceType ) {
                
                localStorage.setItem('deviceType', deviceData.deviceType);
                if(deviceData.deviceType=="clone"){ 
                    localStorage.setItem('templateId', deviceData.templateId);
                }else{ 
                    localStorage.setItem('templateId', deviceData.id);
                }
                
            } 
            if (deviceData.protocol) {
                localStorage.setItem('protocol', deviceData.protocol);
            }
            if (deviceData.ip) {
                localStorage.setItem('ip', deviceData.ip);
            }
            if (deviceData.id) {
                localStorage.setItem('id', deviceData.id);
            }
            if (deviceData.name) {
                localStorage.setItem('name', deviceData.name);
            }
            if (deviceData.remark) {
                localStorage.setItem('remark', deviceData.remark);
            }
            if (deviceData.mqttDeviceId) {
                localStorage.setItem('mqttDeviceId', deviceData.mqttDeviceId);
            }
        },
        
        // 
localStorage
        getDeviceInfo: function() {
            return {
                templateId: localStorage.getItem('templateId'),
                deviceType: localStorage.getItem('clone_type'),
                type: localStorage.getItem('device_type'),
                ip: localStorage.getItem('device_ip'),
                id: localStorage.getItem('device_id'),
                name: localStorage.getItem('device_name'),
                remark: localStorage.getItem('device_remark'),
                mqttDeviceId: localStorage.getItem('device_mqtt_id')
            };
        },
        
        // 
        clearDeviceInfo: function() {
            localStorage.removeItem('templateId');
            localStorage.removeItem('clone_type');
            localStorage.removeItem('device_type');
            localStorage.removeItem('device_ip');
            localStorage.removeItem('device_id');
            localStorage.removeItem('device_name');
            localStorage.removeItem('device_remark');
            localStorage.removeItem('device_mqtt_id');
        },
        
        // 
        isCloneDevice: function(deviceData) {
            return deviceData && deviceData.deviceType === 'clone';
        },
        
        // 
type
        getTemplateType: function(templateId) {
            // 
type
            // 
null
            return null;
        }
    };
    
    // 
script
    window.saveDeviceInfoToLocalStorage = function(deviceData) {
        DeviceInfoManager.saveDeviceInfo(deviceData);
    };
    
    window.getDeviceInfoFromLocalStorage = function() {
        return DeviceInfoManager.getDeviceInfo();
    };
    
    window.clearDeviceInfoFromLocalStorage = function() {
        DeviceInfoManager.clearDeviceInfo();

    function deepFilter(para) {
        // 
filter 
        if (para == null)
            return false;
        // console.log(para);
        return para.filter(item => {
            // filter
            // 
children 
 deepFilter 
            // if(item.children !=null)
            item.children = deepFilter(item.children)
            if (authLev < item.level) {
                return false;//
            }
            if (item.appId != null && item.appId != "PLC") {
                return false;//
            }
            // 
            // arch="MIPS"
            if ("X86" == arch)
                return true;
            if ("ARM64" == arch)
                return true;
            return true;
            // console.log(authLev)
            // console.log(item.level)
            return item.arch.includes(arch)
            // return item.disabled
        })

    function deepFilter(para) {
        // 
filter 
        if (para == null)
            return false;
        // console.log(para);
        return para.filter(item => {
            // filter
            // 
children 
 deepFilter 
            // if(item.children !=null)
            item.children = deepFilter(item.children)
            if (authLev < item.level) {
                return false;//
            }
            if (item.appId != null && item.appId != "PLC") {
                return false;//
            }
            // 
            // arch="MIPS"
            if ("X86" == arch)
                return true;
            if ("ARM64" == arch)
                return true;
            // console.log(authLev)
            // console.log(item.level)
            return item.arch.includes(arch)

(function () {
    // 
    arch = localStorage.getItem('arch')
    appId = localStorage.getItem('appId')
    authLev = localStorage.getItem('authLev')
    function deepFilter(para) {
        // 
filter 
        if (para == null)
            return false;
        // console.log(para);
        return para.filter(item => {
            // filter
            // 
children 
 deepFilter 
            // if(item.children !=null)
            item.children = deepFilter(item.children)
            if (authLev < item.level) {
                return false;//
            }
            if (item.appId != null && item.appId != "PLC") {
                return false;//
            }
            // 
            // arch="MIPS"
            if ("X86" == arch)
                return true;
            if ("ARM64" == arch)
                return true;
            // console.log(authLev)
            // console.log(item.level)
            return item.arch.includes(arch)
            // return item.disabled
        })
    }
